title: Role Model Jokes About Being Maine's Most Famous Person
summary:
Singer Role Model is probably Maine's most famous pop star right now. But is he the most famous person from Maine overall? He talked about that on the Friday premiere of the final season of Amelia Dimoldenberg's "Chicken Shop Date."

Role Model was born Tucker Pillsbury. On the show, he wondered whether he has the most star power of anyone from his home state. "Anna Kendrick's from Maine," he pointed out. The host also noted that famous horror author Stephen King is from Maine.

"He's probably sold more stuff than me," Pillsbury said of King, who is one of the best-selling novelists of all time. "Got more money."

After some back-and-forth, Dimoldenberg told the singer: "You're not as successful as Stephen King, no. That's just a fact."

"You're starting to hurt my feelings," Pillsbury replied. "[He has a] whole different job."

It is still not clear who is Maine's most famous celebrity. Other possible names include actor Patrick Dempsey and sports personality Erin Andrews. Role Model may not have King's sales numbers, but he recently scored his first top 10 album on the Billboard 200 with "Chuck Timely & The Hourglass." It sold 24,000 copies in the United States in its first week, according to Luminate.
why_it_matters: Light interviews like this show how stars joke about fame and success, while the album chart shows how music success is measured.
